title: Concept: Base element points relative URLs at a plaintext origin
description: A plaintext base element re-points every relative URL in the document, so scripts, styles and form targets are fetched over a channel an attacker can rewrite. HTTPS on the page does not protect the subresources the base decides.
applicability: HTTPS responses whose HTML declares a base element.
risk: A network attacker replaces a script or a form target that the document references relatively, and the replacement runs in the origin the user trusts.
